    if = {
        limit = { has_carrier_flag = bca_jr_plan_inc_agri_drone }

        subtract_variable = { which = bca_jr_target value = bca_jr_acc_open_job_count_agri_drone }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable_arithmetic = { which = value:bca_job_agri_drone_food_per_worker value > 0 }
                owner = { check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_remaining_inc_food value > 0 } }
            }
            set_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_candidate value = owner.bca_jr_remaining_inc_food }
            divide_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_candidate value = value:bca_job_agri_drone_food_per_worker }
            divide_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_candidate value = bca_jr_acc_avg_output_efficiency_agri_drone }
            if = {
                limit = { check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_target value > bca_jr_tmp_candidate } }
                set_variable = { which = bca_jr_target value = bca_jr_tmp_candidate }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable_arithmetic = { which = value:bca_job_agri_drone_alloys_per_worker value > 0 }
                owner = { check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_remaining_inc_alloys value > 0 } }
            }
            set_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_candidate value = owner.bca_jr_remaining_inc_alloys }
            divide_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_candidate value = value:bca_job_agri_drone_alloys_per_worker }
            divide_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_candidate value = bca_jr_acc_avg_output_efficiency_agri_drone }

                        clear_variable = bca_jr_remaining_inc_alloys
                    }
                }
            }
        }

            set_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_candidate value = owner.bca_jr_remaining_inc_food }
            divide_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_candidate value = value:bca_job_wrangler_food_per_worker }
            divide_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_candidate value = bca_jr_acc_avg_output_efficiency_wrangler }
            if = {
                limit = { check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_target value > bca_jr_tmp_candidate } }
                set_variable = { which = bca_jr_target value = bca_jr_tmp_candidate }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_target value <= 0 } }

        }

            if = {

            bca_jr_apply_inc_gears = { JOB = wrangler TARGET = bca_jr_target }
            if = {

                    if = {
                        limit = { check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_remaining_inc_society_research value < 0 } }
                        clear_variable = bca_jr_remaining_inc_society_research
                    }
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_actual_job_change value > 0 }

                }
                set_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_resource_delta value = bca_jr_actual_job_change }
                multiply_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_resource_delta value = bca_jr_acc_avg_output_efficiency_wrangler }
                multiply_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_resource_delta value = value:bca_job_wrangler_unity_per_worker }

                    subtract_variable = { which = bca_jr_remaining_inc_unity value = prev.bca_jr_tmp_resource_delta }

                    }

            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_actual_job_change value > 0 }

                multiply_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_resource_delta value = value:bca_job_wrangler_food_per_worker }

                        clear_variable = bca_jr_remaining_inc_food
                    }

    if = {

        set_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_free_capacity value = bca_jr_acc_free_job_count_wrangler }

                check_variable_arithmetic = { which = value:bca_job_wrangler_society_research_per_worker value > 0 }
                owner = { check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_remaining_dec_society_research value > 0 } }
            }
            set_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_candidate value = owner.bca_jr_remaining_dec_society_research }
            divide_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_candidate value = value:bca_job_wrangler_society_research_per_worker }
            divide_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_candidate value = bca_jr_acc_avg_output_efficiency_wrangler }
            add_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_candidate value = bca_jr_acc_free_job_count_wrangler }
            if = {
                limit = { check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_target value > bca_jr_tmp_candidate } }
                set_variable = { which = bca_jr_target value = bca_jr_tmp_candidate }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable_arithmetic = { which = value:bca_job_wrangler_unity_per_worker value > 0 }
                owner = { check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_remaining_dec_unity value > 0 } }
            }
            set_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_candidate value = owner.bca_jr_remaining_dec_unity }
            divide_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_candidate value = value:bca_job_wrangler_unity_per_worker }
            divide_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_candidate value = bca_jr_acc_avg_output_efficiency_wrangler }
            add_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_candidate value = bca_jr_acc_free_job_count_wrangler }
            if = {
                limit = { check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_target value > bca_jr_tmp_candidate } }
                set_variable = { which = bca_jr_target value = bca_jr_tmp_candidate }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable_arithmetic = { which = value:bca_job_wrangler_food_per_worker value > 0 }
                owner = { check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_remaining_dec_food value > 0 } }
            }
            set_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_candidate value = owner.bca_jr_remaining_dec_food }
            divide_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_candidate value = value:bca_job_wrangler_food_per_worker }
            divide_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_candidate value = bca_jr_acc_avg_output_efficiency_wrangler }
            add_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_candidate value = bca_jr_acc_free_job_count_wrangler }

        if = {

            if = {

            bca_jr_apply_dec_gears = { JOB = wrangler TARGET = bca_jr_target }
            set_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_assigned_delta value = bca_jr_actual_job_change }
            subtract_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_assigned_delta value = bca_jr_acc_free_job_count_wrangler }

            if = {

                multiply_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_resource_delta value = bca_jr_acc_avg_output_efficiency_wrangler }
                multiply_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_resource_delta value = value:bca_job_wrangler_society_research_per_worker }
                owner = {
                    subtract_variable = { which = bca_jr_remaining_dec_society_research value = prev.bca_jr_tmp_resource_delta }
                    if = {
                        limit = { check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_remaining_dec_society_research value < 0 } }

            if = {

                multiply_variable = { which = bca_jr_tmp_resource_delta value = value:bca_job_wrangler_unity_per_worker }
                owner = {
                    subtract_variable = { which = bca_jr_remaining_dec_unity value = prev.bca_jr_tmp_resource_delta }
                    if = {

    clear_variable = bca_jr_tmp_free_capacity
    clear_variable = bca_jr_tmp_open_capacity

}
